rundown: Jets beat Islanders 4-3 (OT) at Canada Life Centre in Winnipeg in front of 13,161. It was level at 3-3 after two periods.
7 goals in all. Jets's last: Josh Morrissey Goal Wrist Shot, assists: Mark Scheifele (22), Kyle Connor (10), 4th period 1:58.
Leading the way — Islanders: Kyle Palmieri 1 goal, 1 pts; Casey Cizikas 1 ast. Jets: Kyle Connor 1 goal; Mark Scheifele 3 ast, 3 pts.
Where Jets won it: they scored 1 on the power play to 0 and out-hit them 24-13.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Jets closed as 1.5-goal favorites and won but didn't cover (Islanders +1.5 cashed); the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 7, over by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 19, 6:58 PM ET. It had Islanders 51% and Jets 49%, projecting Islanders 3 – Jets 2.9 (5.9 total, Islanders by 0).

Final: Islanders 3 – Jets 4. Wrong winner: it had Islanders at 51%, and Jets (49%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Islanders came in with a league-average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (10-6-4, 3.3 scored and 2.9 allowed a game over 20 games), worth about 77 and 77 games of evidence. Projected to score 3, they scored 3 (+0 goals, 1% over); projected to allow 2.9, they allowed 4 (+1.1 goals, 36% over).

Jets came in with a 3% below average attack and a league-average defense (10-9-3, 3 scored and 3.4 allowed a game over 22 games), worth about 80 and 81 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.9, they scored 4 (+1.1 goals, 36% over); projected to allow 3, they allowed 3 (+0 goals, 1% over).

The bigger miss was Jets' scoring (+1.1 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 7 against 5.9 projected (+1.1), about the 67th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Jets by 1 against Islanders by 0 projected, about the 66th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
WPG ML (-118) at -118: the algo gave it 51% vs 52% fair (-0.3 pts) — won (+0.8u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 52%). NYI ML (-102) at -102: the algo gave it 49% vs 48% fair (+0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 48%). WPG -1.5 (+205) at +205: the algo gave it 31% vs 31% fair (-0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. NYI +1.5 (-250) at -250: the algo gave it 69% vs 69% fair (+0.6 pts) — won (+0.4u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 55% of bets on Islanders, 38% of the money — Islanders covered; total: 84% of bets on the over, 87% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 55% of bets on Islanders, 60% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Jets, who won and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.107 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +0.8 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 102 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.945 and gives home teams -0.2 goals. Team corrections so far: Islanders attack ×1.040, defense ×1.007 (7 games); Jets attack ×1.040, defense ×0.974 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
